is_deleted = 0
AND dict_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.dictType}, '%')
AND dict_label LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.dictLabel}, '%')
AND status = #{q.status}
ORDER BY dict_type ASC, sort_num ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_dict WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0 AND dict_type = #{dictType} ORDER BY sort_num ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_dict WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

AND id <> #{excludeId}

dict_type = #{dictType}, dict_label = #{dictLabel}, dict_value = #{dictValue}, sort_num = #{sortNum}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime},
